scope: Five narrow actual supported workflows only; this is not blanket approval for original R/GR groups, API renames or private machinery removal.

items.title: Synchronous network requests that block the UI thread
items.actual_loss: The framework would no longer issue async:false requests or return after a synchronous network round trip while blocking browser interaction.

evidence.note: Literal async:true is caller-overridable and request options reach NA.ajax at submit.
Request inherits AjaxSettingsBase and explicitly declares deprecated async:false.
Documented per-call async flag.
Bundled transport passes i.async to XMLHttpRequest.open.

items.caller_status: Shipped public option and executing transport branch; no concrete synchronous application request was identified in this bounded source review. External callers remain unknown.

modern_route.available: createCommunicator already returns a Promise and accepts cancellation; complete required ordered policy/timeout behavior in M3.1/M3.2.
modern_route.migration: Await the request and express dependent work after it. Own a pending/disabled state for the relevant action instead of blocking the whole browser.
modern_route.not_equivalent: Asynchronous sequencing does not reproduce a blocked main thread.

items.user_cost: Convert synchronous call chains to async/await and handle pending/error/cancel explicitly. A caller relying on blocked browser interaction must change its flow.
items.if_declined: Keep this outcome required in M3.2 and design a reviewed native transport route; no jQuery dependency is restored.

items.title: Framework-provided JSONP transport for JSONP-only endpoints
items.actual_loss: The communicator would no longer call a JSONP endpoint by injecting a callback script, including callback-name/script transport configuration.

evidence.note: JSONP response transport and callback query behavior are documented inherited settings.
Other Ajax settings pass through except overwritten lifecycle callbacks.
NA.ajax receives the assembled request options.
Bundled json/jsonp prefilter and script transport implement the workflow.

items.caller_status: The inherited option reaches a bundled implementation. No concrete JSONP-only application endpoint was identified; external consumers are unknown.

modern_route.available: Ordinary JSON over native HTTP is the retained communication owner; remaining CORS/credentials/header policies belong to M3.2.
modern_route.migration: Use an endpoint that returns JSON with the required CORS policy, or an application backend proxy.
modern_route.not_equivalent: A browser fetch to a server that provides only JSONP is not an equivalent replacement. The endpoint or application integration may need a change.

items.user_cost: Potential server CORS/response change or backend proxy. This can require work outside frontend code.
items.if_declined: Keep JSONP as required M3.2 transport capability and review its specific implementation/cancellation ownership.

items.title: Automatic execution of scripts received as HTML or script responses
items.actual_loss: Remote HTML would no longer execute embedded scripts to declare/discover its controller; a dataType:script response would no longer execute as request success. This includes the old one-HTML-file executable block distribution workflow.

evidence.note: jQuery HTML/append/replacement insertion precedes controller lookup/init.
The controller is discovered from the inserted view and initialized.
Documented load sequence explicitly executes inline script, declares the controller, then discovers and initializes it.
The authored block layout includes View plus inline Controller script.
The script response type executes JavaScript.
Bundled HTML insertion/script conversion provides execution.

items.caller_status: Concrete shipped CVC block-page convention and examples; the script data transport is also available through inherited settings.

modern_route.available: PageDefinition already explicitly connects an inert view with a controller factory and independent lifetime. ESM application modules remain executable application code.
modern_route.migration: Move controller code into a TS/ESM module, explicitly connect it to the authored HTML, and use the common M3.3 loader in all containers. Deliberate module import stays application-owned.
modern_route.not_equivalent: The new architecture does not automatically run arbitrary response text or discover a controller created by that text.

items.user_cost: Split executable block HTML into authored view plus controller module and update page registration/loading. Keep HTML/CSS and CVC behavior.
preserve: Explicit controller modules and dynamic application imports
items.if_declined: Keep the exact executable-block/script workflow required for M3.2/M3.3 review; do not silently claim explicit ESM alone is identical.

items.title: Compiling JavaScript string filter conditions at runtime
items.actual_loss: The framework would no longer accept a string such as age > 20 and compile it as JavaScript with new Function. Runtime condition text would need an explicit application interpretation step.

evidence.note: String conditions are rewritten and compiled with new Function; predicate functions use a separate branch.
Both function and string condition contracts are documented, including examples and known rewrite defects.

items.caller_status: Documented callable framework capability. Repository examples also demonstrate predicate alternatives; external text-configured callers remain unknown.

modern_route.available: GridHandle.setFilter and ListHandle.setFilter already accept typed predicates; native Array.filter serves application data.
modern_route.migration: Convert authored conditions to predicates, for example row => row.age > 20. If conditions are external data, the application owns an explicit allowed condition schema/parser.
modern_route.not_equivalent: A predicate API does not by itself execute a received JavaScript expression string.

items.user_cost: Rewrite string conditions as functions. Applications that load condition text need their own explicit interpretation policy.
preserve: Correct logical AND and spaces inside values
items.if_declined: Keep runtime string-condition capability required in M3.8 without copying the legacy AND-to-OR or whitespace corruption defects.

items.title: Inspecting or reprioritizing already installed arbitrary jQuery handlers
items.actual_loss: The framework would no longer return another library existing jQuery handler/type/namespace records or insert a newly registered handler ahead of unknown existing handlers by changing their internal order.

evidence.note: tpBind registers a handler and moves a jQuery handler entry to the front.
events exposes jQuery internal handler collections.
Priority insertion is documented.
Public event/type/namespace enumeration is documented.
The documented blocking example uses priority insertion.

items.caller_status: Actual public introspection and priority APIs, also used internally for duplicate-binding and disabling. The internal UI outcomes remain required; arbitrary external introspection is the proposed loss.

modern_route.available: Native listeners, owned teardown and explicit controller/row hooks are existing owners; finish deterministic binding-before-action and disabled/canceled interaction in M3.7/M6.7.
modern_route.migration: Keep application-owned listener references/metadata and register actions through the declared order. Use available browser development tools for external handler debugging.
modern_route.not_equivalent: This does not offer a programmatic inventory or reordering of arbitrary already-installed third-party handlers.

items.user_cost: Replace integrations that inspect jQuery internal event records. Explicitly own listener registration/order; a generic external-handler manipulation tool is no longer supplied.
items.if_declined: Keep the precise introspection/priority workflow required in M3.8; do not classify every native event or cancellation feature as omitted.

required_without_omission.disposition: Only O03 automatic response-code execution is proposed; CVC/remote inert views/controller lifecycle stay required.
No omission proposed. Preserve before/after/around/error, useful path/view/custom-pointcut workflows and explicit receiver/async behavior through reviewed modern composition.

No UI behavior omission proposed. Typed declarations/code loading/defaults/actions/search/row events must preserve outcomes; old property spellings and declaration-to-handle mutation are API migration, not separate feature deletion.
No omission proposed. Scoped services/handles and deliberate live defaults/locale/messages/rules must preserve useful shared configuration and lookup workflows.
No omission proposed. Preserve useful custom inspection/findings/exclusions/severity/abort/debugging outcomes through a reviewed scoped workflow; lint/sourcemaps alone are not proof.
Only O04 and O05 narrow capabilities are proposed. Predicate filtering, projection, ordering, cancel/disabled/binding-before-action stay required.

Only O01/O02/O03 are proposed. Ordinary HTTP/settings, custom transform/transport outcomes, headers/status/progress, wire recipes/error/completion/cancel remain required. Old jqXHR method spelling alone is API migration.

No blanket omission proposed. Retain bound rules and resolve supported standalone dataset/manual-format/unformat/validate workflows through the existing rule owner; no convenience catalog is recreated.

Separate existing authorization: remove only proven unused/unrelated convenience code after direct/transitive/config/declaration/alias/external reachability proof. Used private outcomes remain. No new removal approval is inferred.
No omission proposed. Classify actual non-JSON/inherited/mutable callers and preserve useful outcomes or explicitly return a genuine loss to this decision; canonical JSON alone does not prove parity.
No omission proposed. Resolve useful per-key/unbound/no-op/old-value/local-global/receiver timing; normalization recipes are not exact timing proof. Do not reproduce silent corruption as a feature.
No omission proposed. Explicitly resolve standalone partial-input/deleting/error diagnostics and preserve required UI mask behavior.
No omission proposed. Retain useful topology/inspection/customization outcomes through authored native tables/column plans and concrete migration, rather than old mutable field names.
No omission proposed. Preserve pinning/footer/resize/reflow/customization through measured layout/CSS/column state; old pixel knob spelling alone is not a feature loss.
No separate decision. Preserve Grid declarations/code choices/row actions and binding-before-action under core:R03.

decision_rule: Ask once with all five concrete items and costs. Record explicit item decisions. Rejected, unanswered and unlisted outcomes remain required; approval never follows from silence or this document.

p01_inventory_conclusion.basis: Exact origin pointers, all secondary profiles/local/default acceptance, concrete source cases and decision candidates resolve through the frozen registry and two preflight inputs. Independent source-case reviews found no remaining known-origin/case assignment gap after corrected UI/Grid snapshot provenance.
p01_inventory_conclusion.what_remains: P0.1 known-source inventory acceptance is complete and does not depend on P0.2 approval. Future detailed contracts, implementation/tests and newly discovered actual-scope branches remain assigned to their fixed owners.
not_claimed: Discovery of every private external application

scope_boundary.unrelated_helpers: Existing authorization remains conditional on separate reachability proof; no extension/convenience package.
